basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old graphic designer living in Philadelphia, PA. I've been on a recovery journey from anorexia for a few years, using my experiences to connect with others in similar situations. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the Pocono Mountains, exploring new music genres, and volunteering at local animal shelters. I'm a night owl, typically online during late evenings, and I work freelance, which gives me a flexible schedule. I'm currently single and focusing on self-care and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having battled anorexia for over a decade, I have extensive personal experience with eating disorders and recovery. I regularly participate in therapy and support groups, which has deepened my understanding of mental health. Additionally, my graphic design work keeps me updated with the latest trends and tools in creative software.
